edge_sample.source_text: lemma Shapiro's Lemma: Let $S$ be a subgroup of $G$. Then there are isomorphisms for all $n \ge 0$: \[ H^n(G,\mathrm{coind}_S(M)) \cong H^n(S,M), \qquad H_n(G,\mathrm{ind}_S(M)) \cong H_n(S,M), \qquad \] More precisely these are isomorphisms of functors.
edge_sample.target_text: proof : This follows from Shapiro's lemma (\ref{lem:Shapiro}) together with the calculation of the cohomology of a cyclic group with values in ${\mathbb Z}$ (\ref{lem:H2 cyclic Z}).
